jobs.occupation: PhD Student in Robotics and Artificial Intelligence
jobs.description:
Are you ready to take the next step in your academic journey? As a doctoral student with us, you will work closely with leading researchers in a strong, international research environment, with access to advanced laboratory equipment and solid funding opportunities. You will be offered secure employment, high-quality supervision, and room to grow, both as a researcher and as a person.
https://www.ltu.se/research/subjects/RoboticsAI?l=en, RAI, at the Deaprtment of Computer Science, Electrical and Space Engineeering at Luleå University of Technology is now looking for a PhD student to contribute to our growing activities. The RAI team conducts basic and fundamental research into all aspects of robotics, with a specific focus on aerial, space and bio-inspired robotics.
 
 
Subject description
 
Robotics and artificial intelligence aim to develop novel robotic systems that are characterised by advanced autonomy for improving the ability of robots to interact with the surrounding environment and humans during the execution of specific tasks.
 
 
Project description
 
RAI’s fundamental vision is to bridge the gap between theory and reality, and the team has a strong background in field robotics. Specific application areas we focus on include long-term autonomous missions in large and uncertain environments, semantic mission planning using foundation models, agentic task decomposition and event-driven replanning, and autonomous, semantically aware inspection of complex infrastructure. The RAI team has strong European and national participation in several research, development and innovation projects.
 
 
Duties
 
As a PhD student, you will conduct research with substantial theoretical and experimental components, to be published in peer-reviewed, internationally recognized journals and at major conferences. The position includes supervising degree projects and providing support with applications for funding from research funding agencies or councils, EU framework programmes or industry. The position may also include teaching assistance, seminars and presentations. You will work in the field of robot autonomy, and all activities will be linked to national, European and global research and development projects. The PhD position will involve intensive research activities in field experimentation and theoretical development. Research areas:
 
 
Long-term autonomy in uncertain environments
 
a. Agentic planning and reasoning
 
- Semantic mission planning using foundation models
 
- Task decomposition based on foundation models
 
- Event-driven task replanning
 
 
b. Autonomous inspection planning
 
- Uncertainty aware planning
 
- Multi-agent systems for inspection planning
 
 
Qualifications
 
To qualify for the position, you must hold a master’s degree in electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, computer science or another relevant subject. Good knowledge of C++, Python and ROS 2 is required. Good scientific skills, with demonstrated proficiency in experimental research, and very good communication skills are an advantage. You will represent the group in various contexts, both in Sweden and abroad, so very good knowledge of English is required.
 
 
For further information about a specific subject see http://www.ltu.se/research/Utbildning-pa-forskarniva/Studieplaner/Allmanna-studieplaner-Teknisk-fakultetsnamnd?l=en.
 
 
Further information
 
Employment as a PhD student is limited to four years. Teaching and other departmental duties may be added, up to 20% of full-time working hours. The place of work is Luleå, and the starting date is by agreement.
 
 
For each position, a preliminary https://www.ltu.se/en/about-the-university/work-with-us/applying-for-a-job#h-Informationonpaytransparency is provided based on the requirements, responsibilities, and market conditions associated with the role.
 
 
For further information, please contact:
 
George Nikolakopoulos, Chaired Professor, +46 920-49 1298 mailto:geonik@ltu.se
 
 
https://www.ltu.se/en/about-the-university/work-with-us/applying-for-a-job#h-Tradeunioncontactsrepresentatives
 
 
In case of different interpretations of the English and Swedish versions o this announcement, the Swedish version takes precedence.
 
 
Application
 
We prefer that you apply for this position by clicking on the apply button below. The application should include a CV, personal letter and copies of verified diplomas from high school and universities. Mark your application with the reference number below. Your application, including diplomas, must be written in English or Swedish.
 
 
Closing date for applications: 7 December 2026
 
Reference number: 5833-2026

jobs.description:
Spanish Teacher / Spansklärare 30%

Internationella Engelska Skolan Falun is a school for grades 4-9 with 450 students. The school started in 2014 and has since grown and established itself. The school is located near Falun center, close to buses and parks.

The school has an international focus and teaching is conducted in both English and Swedish depending on the subject. The school works to put learning and knowledge first. We are a school with a clear set of values, with a safe work environment, good discipline and a lot of care. Students must learn to take personal responsibility for their development and work environment and to respect their schoolmates, teachers and themselves.

We are looking for a qualified Spanish teacher to join our team in January 2027.

What we offer

✔ A real international workplace with colleagues from all over the world

✔ All IES schools in Sweden are based on the same foundations for the vision of the school, namely the IES Ethos. Feel free to read more about this and see if they align with your own professional values ​​and beliefs.

✔ At IES all employees receive a pedagogical lunch. 

Your mission

✔ You need to have the qualifications and competence to teach years 6-9 in Spanish.

✔ The position is a permanent employment of 30% and includes teaching for groups of students in years 6-9. 

At our school you get to work together with driven and committed colleagues who, together with the students, find new ways to learn and understand their world. By combining language, creativity and high academic quality, we help our students reach their full potential.

Your profile

✔ We believe that you are creative, responsible and innovative. 

✔ You are committed to your work and have the ability to engage others. Experience of similar roles is an advantage. 

✔ You are motivated by having regular contact with guardians and collaborating with colleagues in a supportive environment.

✔ You value and deliver a personal, clear and balanced leadership with both control and student engagement in focus. As a teacher, you are a clear and an active standard setter.

✔ Adequate university education and teaching credentials are a prerequisite. You have a professional appearance when dealing with students, guardians and colleagues.

✔ There are no requirements for previous teaching experience, but we would like you to be confident in your professional leadership where you can create a safe and stable environment both inside and outside the classroom.

✔ Swedish teacher qualifications and previous experience are an advantage.

For permanent positions Swedish qualifications (lärarlegitimation) is required.

Do not hesitate to send in your application or contact us for further conversation. Based on who you are and what your qualifications look like, we can plan the organization in slightly different ways.

Please submit your CV and cover letter through IES Careers. Interviews are ongoing and the deadline for applications is 22 November 2026.

Questions can be referred to Principal Carolina Browall at principal.falun@engelska.se

Join our team at Sinch as a Data Engineer III, where you'll help design, build, maintain, and optimize data pipelines across our global product portfolio. You'll have the opportunity to work with modern technologies, embrace AI-assisted development, and explore emerging innovations such as AI agents, agentic workflows, and intelligent automation to help shape the future of data engineering at Sinch.
We're looking for someone with a solid foundation in SQL, Python, and ETL/ELT, who enjoys solving complex challenges and building scalable, reliable data solutions. We value curiosity, a collaborative mindset, and an interest in exploring how AI-powered development tools, LLMs, and AI agents can simplify engineering tasks, improve productivity, and create new opportunities for automation across our data platforms.
This role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to impactful initiatives in a rapidly growing global business, develop your technical expertise, and experiment with new approaches to building and operating modern data solutions.
Contribute to high-impact data engineering initiatives, delivering reliable and scalable solutions that create value for our customers and business.
Support data integration efforts across diverse platforms and products, enabling seamless and efficient data movement throughout Sinch.
Build, optimize, monitor, and maintain data pipelines, ensuring high standards of performance, quality, and reliability.
Identify opportunities for improvement in our data pipelines, development processes, and engineering practices.
Leverage AI-assisted development tools to accelerate coding, testing, debugging, and documentation while maintaining high code quality.
Explore emerging AI technologies, including AI agents and agentic workflows, to support automation, simplify data operations, and improve engineering efficiency.
Collaborate on data engineering projects, taking ownership of assigned tasks and contributing to their successful delivery.
Continuously learn and experiment with modern data engineering technologies, sharing knowledge and contributing to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.

REQUIREMENTS 
We believe you bring solid expertise in diverse data landscapes, coupled with proficiency in Informatica for the development and governance of pipelines. Your essential experience with virtualization tools, as well as your demonstrated capability in real-time data processing and analytics sets you apart. As an effective communicator, you effortlessly bridge the technical and business sectors. Your dedication to continual learning ensures that you stay current of industry trends and eagerly adopt new technologies.
Proficient in software development with expertise in Python, Spark, Git, CI/CD, and Docker. 
Skilled in using SQL for data querying and ETL/ELT development. 
Experience in structuring and storing large volumes of data in data lakes and warehouses. 
Capable of fixing and optimizing data pipelines for enhanced performance and reliability. 
Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration tools like Airflow, Dagster, and experience using Databricks.  
Cloud experience in AWS or GCP. 
Knowledgeable about various data architectures such as Data Lake, Data Mesh, and Data Fabric. 
Strong communication skills with fluency in English for engaging with stakeholders from technical and business areas. 

Our corporate language is English, please submit your application in English.
This role is hybrid role based in Stockholm and reporting to the Data Engineering Manager. 
Candidates must have the right to work in Sweden. Relocation and work permit sponsorship are not available for this role.
OUR HIRING PROCESS 
We are committed to ensuring a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and inclusive. Our approach includes structured, competency-based interviews designed to evaluate your skills, experience, and qualifications relevant to the role. At times, we may include a data-driven assessment to enhance our hiring success and identify candidates likely to excel. 
We believe in a two-way process and encourage you to ask questions throughout the journey. If this role isn't what you're looking for, please explore the other opportunities listed on our career page: https://www.sinch.com/careers/. No matter who you are, we hope you find an exciting path forward - hopefully with us!

jobs.description:
Lärare i svenska som andraspråk 50-75%

På International English School (IES) gör vi skillnad för våra elever. Vi tror att detta beror på våra tydliga värderingar och våra engagerade och synliga ledare, som skapar en miljö där lärare kan undervisa och elever kan lära sig. IES-skolorna präglas av en dynamisk, internationell atmosfär med personal och elever från hela världen.

Om Internationella Engelska Skolan i Växjö

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) Växjö ingår i Sveriges största och mest framgångsrika nätverk av tvåspråkiga skolor och tar emot elever i årskurserna F–9.  Vi följer den svenska läroplanen, Lgr22, och upp till 50 procent av undervisningen sker på engelska.

På IES Växjö tror vi på höga akademiska förväntningar, en tvåspråkig utbildning på engelska och svenska samt ömsesidig respekt mellan elever och personal. Vi strävar efter att ge varje elev kunskap, självförtroende och en stark ansvarskänsla för att förbereda dem för framtida framgångar.

Som lärare i SVA kommer du att spela en central roll i att ge SVA-eleverna en trygg och strukturerad tillgång till sin svenska språkundervisning.

Vi söker en person som är en trygg och tydlig ledare med god förståelse för flerspråkighet och andraspråksinlärning.

- planera, genomföra och utvärdera undervisningen i svenska som andraspråk (SVA)
- bedöma och följa upp elevernas språkliga och akademiska utveckling
- skapa individuellt anpassade undervisningsplaner utifrån elevernas behov
- undervisa individuellt, i små grupper och, vid behov, genom samundervisning i den vanliga klassen
- identifiera behovet av ytterligare anpassningar och särskilt stöd
- arbeta nära ämneslärare, mentorer, specialpedagoger, elevvårdsteamet och skolans ledning
- stödja kollegor i deras arbete med språkutvecklande undervisningsmetoder och differentierad undervisning
- upprätthålla en nära och tydlig dialog med föräldrar och vårdnadshavare om elevernas språkutveckling och framsteg i skolan
- dokumentera, följa upp och utvärdera elevernas framsteg
- arbeta i enlighet med IES:s tre kärnvärden: Behärskning av det engelska språket, En trygg och ordnad miljö samt Höga akademiska förväntningar.

Du har förmågan att bygga starka och förtroendefulla relationer med elever i olika åldrar. Du ser möjligheterna och styrkorna i en mångkulturell skolmiljö och har höga förväntningar på alla elevers förmåga att utvecklas.

Du är organiserad, flexibel och analytisk. Du kan arbeta självständigt men trivs också med att samarbeta med kollegor kring elevernas utveckling och behov.

Vi söker dig som har SVA-kompetens och betydande erfarenhet av att undervisa i SVA.

Ansökan

Om du vill bli en del av en dynamisk skola med engagerade lärare, skicka in ditt CV och ditt personliga brev via vårt rekryteringssystem. Vi ser att du har:

- en lärarexamen och lärarbehörighet, helst med behörighet att undervisa i svenska som andraspråk
- kunskap om nyanlända elevers lärande och språkutveckling
- god förståelse för relevanta riktlinjer och bedömningsmaterial
- god förmåga att kommunicera på engelska, eftersom engelska är ett vanligt arbetsspråk på skolan
- goda digitala färdigheter och erfarenhet av pedagogisk dokumentation.
- erfarenhet av att undervisa elever i olika åldersgrupper
- erfarenhet av arbete med elever med särskilda behov, extra anpassningar och särskilt stöd

Intervjuer hålls löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdagen. Vi undanber oss vänligen men bestämt kontakt från rekryteringsföretag och annonssäljare.

jobs.occupation: Maintenance Foreman till SMS group Nordic.
jobs.description:
SMS group är ledande inom framtidsinriktade teknologier och god service för metallindustrin. År 2024 genererade vårt team på över 13 500 anställda världen över en omsättning på över 4 miljarder euro. Vi använder våra 150 års erfarenhet och vår digitala expertis för att kontinuerligt tillhandahålla branschen med innovativa produkter och processer som sträcker sig bortom vår kärnverksamhet. Vi är den rätta partnern för utmanande projekt och stödjer våra kunder genom hela livscykeln för deras anläggningar och utrustning. Att bana vägen för en koldioxidneutral och hållbar metallindustri är vårt uttalade mål.
Om rollen / About the role
Svenska
Är du en erfaren underhållsledare med gedigen praktisk erfarenhet av tung industriell utrustning? SMS group söker en arbetsledare för mekaniskt underhåll som ska leda verkstadsarbetet och bidra till att kritisk utrustning i stålverket är driftsäker, säker och redo för produktion.
I rollen leder du ett team som ansvarar för reparation, renovering och översyn av utrustning såsom valslipmaskiner, fräsmaskiner, valslagerhus, lagerenheter samt annan verkstads- och stålverksutrustning. Du kombinerar ett närvarande och praktiskt ledarskap på verkstadsgolvet med planering, felsökning och kontinuerligt förbättringsarbete.
Du samordnar underhållsverkstadens dagliga arbete och ser till att prioriteringar, resurser och tekniska krav är tydliga. Du stöttar teamet i att lösa utrustningsproblem och bidrar till förbättringar som stärker säkerheten, kvaliteten och driftsäkerheten.
Dina arbetsuppgifter omfattar bland annat att:
Planera och prioritera verkstadsarbetet utifrån produktionens behov
Ansvara för reparationer, inspektioner, precisionspassning och renovering av utrustning
Felsöka mekaniska, hydrauliska och pneumatiska problem
Utveckla förebyggande underhåll för verkstads- och stålverksutrustning
Stödja grundorsaksanalyser och följa upp korrigerande åtgärder
Följa upp underhållsresultat, bland annat efterlevnad av förebyggande underhåll, MTBF, MTTR och andelen effektivt underhållsarbete
Säkerställa korrekt underhållsdokumentation och effektiv användning av personal, utrustning och reservdelar

Du förväntas föregå med gott exempel och säkerställa att säkerhetsrutiner, inklusive Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), följs. Du har också mandat att stoppa arbetet om säkerhet, kvalitet eller regelefterlevnad riskeras.
English
Are you an experienced maintenance leader with a strong hands-on background in heavy industrial equipment? SMS group is looking for a Mechanical Maintenance Foreman to lead workshop activities and help keep critical steel mill machinery reliable, safe and ready for operation.
In this role, you will lead a team responsible for repairing, rebuilding and overhauling equipment such as roll grinding machines, milling machines, roll chocks, bearing assemblies and other workshop and mill equipment. You will combine practical shop-floor leadership with planning, troubleshooting and continuous improvement.
You will coordinate the daily work of the maintenance workshop, making sure priorities, resources and technical requirements are clear. You will support the team in resolving equipment issues and contribute to improvements that strengthen safety, quality and reliability.
Your responsibilities will include:
Planning and prioritising workshop work in line with production needs
Overseeing repairs, inspections, precision fitting and equipment rebuilds
Troubleshooting mechanical, hydraulic and pneumatic issues
Developing preventive maintenance practices for workshop and mill equipment
Supporting root cause analysis and following up on corrective actions
Monitoring maintenance performance, including preventive maintenance compliance, MTBF, MTTR and wrench time
Ensuring accurate maintenance documentation and effective use of people, equipment and spare parts

You are expected to lead by example and ensure that safety procedures, including Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), are followed. You also have the authority to stop work if safety, quality or compliance may be at risk.
Din profil / Your profile
Svenska
Du har en gedigen bakgrund inom industriellt underhåll och trivs med att kombinera teknisk problemlösning med att stötta ett team. Du är strukturerad, lätt att samarbeta med och trygg i att fatta beslut om arbetsprioriteringar.
Vi söker dig som har:
Erfarenhet av att samordna eller leda yrkesarbetare i en verkstad eller på verkstadsgolvet
Goda kunskaper inom mekaniska system och erfarenhet av hydraulisk och pneumatisk utrustning
Praktisk erfarenhet av utrustning såsom valslagerhus, lagerenheter, valslipmaskiner, fräsmaskiner eller svarvar
Ett strukturerat arbetssätt för underhållsplanering och problemlösning
God kommunikativ förmåga och vana att samarbeta med olika funktioner 
En relevant teknisk högskoleutbildning, yrkesutbildning eller motsvarande erfarenhet

English
You have a solid background in industrial maintenance and enjoy combining technical problem-solving with supporting a team. You are organised, approachable and comfortable making decisions about work priorities.
We are looking for someone with:
Experience coordinating or leading skilled tradespeople in a workshop or on the shop floor
Strong knowledge of mechanical systems, with experience in hydraulic and pneumatic equipment
Practical experience with equipment such as roll chocks, bearing assemblies, roll grinding machines, milling machines or lathes
A structured approach to maintenance planning and problem-solving
Good communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively across functions
A relevant technical degree, vocational qualification or equivalent experience

Är detta för dig? / Is this for you?
Svenska
Låter detta som en intressant möjlighet? Välkommen till en arbetsplats där din utveckling är central och där vi tillsammans skapar morgondagens lösningar. Vi ser fram emot att ta emot din ansökan! Då rekryterings teamet är internationellt önskar vi ditt CV och personliga brev på engelska.
Urval kommer att pågå under ansökningstiden varpå tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum.
English
Does this sound like an interesting opportunity? Welcome to a workplace where your development is central and where we together create tomorrow’s solutions. We look forward to receiving your CV and personal letter in English!
The selection process will be ongoing during the application period, which may lead to that the position may be filled before the last day of application.

Kravprofil
We are searching for a Freeze-drying specialist for an assignment at our customer site in Stockholm.
The Freeze-Drying Specialist will support recipe development, process scale-up, troubleshooting of products and processes, and procurement of new equipment.
REQUIREMENTS
- PhD, Pharmacist degree, Medical Technology Engineering degree, or equivalent.
- Minimum 6 years of relevant professional experience.
- Experience from working in regulated environment, eg GMP.
- Experience from validation activities.
- Experience in freeze-drying recipe development and process scale-up.
- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
- Fluent communication skills in English and Swedish.
- Ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams.
- Ability to work in office, laboratory, and production environments

Software Engineer
System-level development, background services, and platform logic.
This role suits you if you enjoy understanding what happens under the hood and building stable components that run reliably on hundreds of millions of devices.
Must have
• iOS development experience
• Computer science fundamentals
• Understanding of threads, concurrency, and asynchronous programming
• Ability to write robust, fault-tolerant, and efficient code for long-running processes.
• Strong communication skills and fluent English.
Nice to have
• Knowledge of security, privacy, encryption, or communication protocols.
• Experience with complex or distributed systems.
• Familiarity with Bluetooth or other low-level communication layers.
• Deep understanding of modern Swift concurrency

🚀 We’re Hiring: Senior Embedded Software Application Engineer – Motor Control
Company: Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB
Role: Senior Embedded Software Application Engineer
Specialisation: Embedded Software | Electric Motor Control | MATLAB | Simulink | HIL
Experience: 5+ years
Language: English
Engagement: IT Consulting Assignment
About the Assignment
Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for an experienced Senior Embedded Software Application Engineer for an exciting consulting assignment within motor drive systems software development.
You will be part of a highly skilled engineering team, contributing to the development and functional verification of embedded software for advanced motor drive systems. The role involves hands-on software development, testing, fault tracing and troubleshooting, working closely with cross-functional engineering teams.
Key Responsibilities
Develop embedded software applications for motor drive systems.
Translate system requirements into software requirements and technical solutions.
Perform software design, implementation, documentation and functional verification.
Work with Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing and vehicle/truck-level verification.
Conduct fault tracing, debugging and bug fixing.
Integrate software deliveries and ensure quality and readiness before release.
Take ownership of technical tasks and actively contribute to engineering deliveries.
Collaborate with technical teams and support knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
Contribute to technical development roadmaps and engineering best practices.

Required Skills & Experience
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in embedded software development.
Strong understanding of embedded software development and functional verification.
Practical knowledge of Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing.
Good understanding of electrical motor control.
Experience in application development using MATLAB and Simulink or TargetLink.
Good troubleshooting and analytical problem-solving capabilities.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
Ability to independently drive tasks while collaborating effectively within a team.

Meritorious Experience
Hands-on experience in fault tracing and debugging.
Truck driving license.
Experience within automotive, powertrain control, electromobility or mechatronic systems.

What We’re Looking For
We are looking for a technically strong and proactive professional who takes ownership, enjoys solving complex engineering challenges and contributes positively to the team.
The ideal candidate is also willing to share knowledge, support junior colleagues and continuously develop their technical expertise.
Interested?
If this opportunity matches your experience and career interests, we would be happy to hear from you!
You can also reach out to us directly via LinkedIn.

jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
Substitute teacher 26-27

 Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) har gjort stor skillnad för våra elever i över 30 år. Vi tror att vår framgång beror på vårt tydliga etos med engagerade och närvarande ledare som skapar en miljö där lärare kan undervisa och elever kan lära sig. Vi har en stark kultur som bygger på beprövade rutiner där bemötandet är självklart. Hos oss får lärare fokusera på undervisning och lärande, med eleverna i centrum för allt vi gör. IES Hässelby är en skola för årskurserna 4-9 med ca 490 elever och 60 medarbetare. Vi är en tvåspråkig skola som följer den svenska läroplanen. Skolan ligger i Hässelby Strand, strax utanför Stockholm, en kort promenad från Grimsta naturreservat, vackra Mälaren och Hässelby strands tunnelbanestation.

 Vi söker nu lärarvikarier omgående. Som timvikarie hos IES Hässelby arbetar du enligt överenskommelse. Förfrågan kan ofta komma med kort varsel. Arbetet ställer krav på att du som person trivs med att arbeta med barn i olika åldrar, känner dig bekväm med att undervisa i alla ämnen samt har lätt för att anpassa dig till nya rutiner och arbetssätt.

 Vi söker dig som har: ● Avslutad gymnasieutbildning ● Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska ● Har tidigare erfarenhet av att arbeta med barn

 Meriterande om du har: ● Relevant utbildning, alternativt en pågående lärarutbildning

 För att arbeta i skola och förskola är det krav på ett aktuellt utdrag ur belastningsregistret. Har du inget hemma så beställ ett redan idag genom att klicka på länken nedan! https://polisen.se/tjanster-tillstand/belastningsregistret/skola-eller-forskola/

 Skriv gärna ett personligt brev, bifoga CV och ansök redan idag. Rekrytering sker löpande, skicka därför in din ansökan så snart som möjligt till info.hasselby@engelska.se. Märk ansökan med “Intresseanmälan timvikarie”

 Välkommen med din ansökan!

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

N.B. Prior to any offer of employment at IES, a criminal background check is required for all applicants. In Sweden, this is an extract from belastningsregistret from Polismyndigheten and from abroad, this is a record extract from an equivalent police governing body.

Mechanical Design Engineer – Advanced Vehicle Concept Development
Employer: Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB
Location: Södertälje, Stockholm County, Sweden
Employment Type: Full-time (100%)
Assignment Period: 12 October 2026 – 31 October 2028
Working Language: English (Swedish is considered an advantage but is not required.)

About the Role
Hykmann Global Business Solutions AB is looking for an experienced Mechanical Design Engineer to join an assignment with one of Sweden's leading automotive engineering teams in Södertälje.
The assignment focuses on advanced engineering and concept vehicle development, where new technologies within electrification, hydrogen, and e-Mining are explored and developed for future vehicle platforms.
You will work in a fast-paced research and development environment, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams across R&D, Production, and other engineering stakeholders. The role requires a flexible and solution-oriented engineer who enjoys working with concept development and evolving technical requirements.
Key Responsibilities
Contribute to concept development and early-phase mechanical design for advanced vehicle platforms.
Create and maintain 3D models and concept-level drawings using CATIA V5.
Develop technical solutions for cooling systems, braking systems, steering systems, and battery installations.
Support vehicle layout and packaging activities to ensure design feasibility.
Collaborate with R&D, Production, Manufacturing Engineering, and other cross-functional stakeholders throughout the development process.
Perform or support FEM calculations and design validation activities.
Participate in technical reviews and contribute to continuous improvement of engineering solutions.
Deliver concept-level design solutions within project timelines while maintaining engineering quality.

Required Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
Minimum 7 years of professional experience in mechanical design or a related engineering field.
Strong experience in concept development and early-stage product development within the automotive or heavy vehicle industry.
Proven hands-on experience with CATIA V5 (3D) for mechanical design and assemblies.
Good knowledge of ENOVIA or a similar Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) system.
Experience in designing and integrating Battery Electric Vehicle (BEV) solutions.
Good understanding of vehicle layout, packaging, and system integration.
Experience with cooling systems, braking systems, steering systems, or battery components is highly meritorious.
Knowledge of Finite Element Method (FEM) for design validation is an advantage.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced engineering environment with changing project requirements.
Strong communication and collaboration skills with multidisciplinary engineering teams.
Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

Who You Are

Öppen för alla
Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.
